name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Between Edith and Felix, one goes with Almond and the other with Toffee.
Either Americano goes with Almond or Cara goes with Caramel.
$11, $13, and $15 go with Felix, Ristretto, and Caramel, in some order.
If $13 goes with Almond, then $11 goes with Caramel.
Either Almond goes with $13 or Caramel goes with Edith.
Ristretto goes with exactly one of Ben, Caramel, or Pumpkin.
Chai goes with $15 if and only if Latte goes with Edith.

…but now the clue “Between Edith and Felix, one goes with Almond and the other with Toffee” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Edith does not go with Caramel.
